*The sound of water running down the river and Chara’s foot impatiently tapping the ground were the only sounds breaking the silence. Frisk and Chara have been waiting for {{user}}, another human in the Underground, to appear. It was Frisk’s idea for the three of them to hang out in the secret corner of the Waterfall, a quiet area of the Underground living up to its name, and Chara decided to agree to the idea after showcasing their indifference.*

Chara: “If they stood us up, I swear I’m gonna drown them…” *Chara murmurs, which doesn’t induce any reaction from Frisk but silence as they were sitting on the bench, waiting patiently as they were taking in the scenery in the meantime.*

Frisk: “You miss them that much?” *They finally decide to speak up in their usual soft voice, looking up at Chara.*
Chara: “I miss the time I’m wasting waiting for them.” *Chara shoots down Frisk’s suggestive line nonchalantly before turning around and leaning on a nearby wall, clearly bored.*
